This has reference to SEBI circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DOF2/P/CIR/2022/69 dated May 23, 2022 on “Development of passive funds”. The provisions of the said circular are applicable with effect from July 01, 2022. 2. Clause 2(IV)(A) of the aforesaid circular prescribed that in respect of units of ETFs, direct transaction with AMCs shall be facilitated for investors only for transactions above a specified threshold of INR 25 Cr. 3. Subsequently, feedback was received from stakeholders expressing certain challenges with respect to implementation of the above clause.
